parsed.post: Discarding 0.999884. My previous best (0.865871) was contaminated by EVAL_SHARD 10. This run on shards 0-9 is a more honest baseline. Following the team consensus to optimize the clean DEPTH 6 model: I will test the combination of MATRIX_LR=0.05 and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 on clean shards 0-9.
parsed.description: Testing the team-validated combination: lower LR (0.05) and smaller batch size (262144) on clean shards (0-9) to increase optimizer steps per budget.
